title: Procurement Arrangements for Construction of Government Quarantine Facilities, Community Recovery Facilities and Community Care Facilities
what_it_is: Procurement Arrangements for Construction of Government Quarantine Facilities, Community Recovery Facilities and Community Care Facilities

sections.label: Emergency Procurement for Hotels and Fit-outs
sections.summary: Hotel contracting and fit-out works were done under Emergency Procurement, which allows waived tenders and direct awards, with CCF and CRF decisions approved by the Multi Ministry Taskforce.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: The contracting of hotels and the construction of fit-out works were undertaken under Emergency Procurement, as my colleague Second Minister Indranee has highlighted earlier.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: The Emergency Procurement procedure allows for tenders to be waived and for contracts to be directly awarded to vendors with the necessary experience, expertise and resources to get the job done within a short period of time.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: All decisions for the setting up of CCFs and CRFs are, therefore, approved by the Multi Ministry Taskforce.

sections.label: Non-emergency Procurement and Open Tenders
sections.summary: The question asks whether the Task Force will consider more open tenders for quarantine and stay-home facilities, and agencies may use GeBIZ if conditions stabilise.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
sentences.text: My question is on non-emergency procurement, going forward, with regard to perhaps quarantine facilities, stay-at-home facilities, whether the Task Force – as alluded to by the Second Minister for Finance – is considering more open tender processes, so Singaporean companies, other companies can participate, in light of the economic situation.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: Certainly, looking forward, if the situation were to stabilise and the conditions permit, agencies will consider going beyond emergency procurement to get more quotes or even to go through contracting via GeBIZ.

sections.label: Agencies Engage Multiple Vendors
sections.summary: Even under emergency procurement, agencies engage a few vendors for works and services, check quotations, and use a range of suppliers, which will continue.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Walter Theseira (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: I think that would be very important to not only give us a good price and quality of goods and services, but also to assure enterprises that they will be able to help out and participate, and also, help their bottom line out a bit.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: I would say that even under the scenario of emergency procurement today, agencies do not immediately go with one vendor.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: So, the various agencies that are looking at all sorts of contracting procurement requirements do already today engage a few vendors – whether it is for are M&E works, whether it is for consultancy services and then they get the quotes.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: Even though it is not required under emergency procurement, they could have gone directly.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: They check the different quotations and then they go with a supplier.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: So, a range of different suppliers are already being used under today's scenario and that situation will continue.
